title: fleet-write relay re-runs failed jobs only for ci.yml, so a seat cannot clear an infra-red check in another workflow
body:
security#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcT1w3zpekijraHJE4f

## Why this card exists

The maintainer, in this seat's session (`session_017xRBcT1w3zpekijraHJE4f`), on 2026-11-08, about a seat PR stuck on a red non-required check, verbatim:

> 31469 这种你应该自己处理

and, on this card's scope:

> skills应该立卡更新，以后这种问题都应该自己处理

## What was measured (2026-11-08)

- On PR #31469, `Check Documentation Links` (workflow `.github/workflows/check-links.yml`) was red on two heads in a row for an infrastructure reason only. The job log says: "lychee setup failed twice (binary download, curl exit 22). No links were checked — see #8238. Re-run the job."
- `node scripts/pm/rerun-failed.mjs --run 42470905626` refused before dispatch: "fence `workflow`: … the relay re-runs only a run whose path is one of .github/workflows/ci.yml — a closed list, matched whole" (`RERUN_FAILED_WORKFLOWS` in `scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs`).
- The queue-entry rule requires every check to be green or an expected skip, not only the required subset. So the seat could not land the PR, and the only remedies were a human re-run or an unrelated new push.

## Rule wanted

A seat can re-run, once, the failed jobs of any workflow run whose log proves it measured nothing (an infrastructure setup failure). It does so through the same relay op with the same once-only and head-check fences, so a flaky infra check never needs a human click.

## Skills rule wanted (pm-dispatch)

The landing references (`references/landing-operations.md`, with `references/platform-readings.md` for the readings) say that a check which is red for an infrastructure reason, and whose own log says it measured nothing, is the seat's to clear. The seat never asks the maintainer to click a re-run. The order is:
1. Re-run its failed jobs once through the relay.
2. If that is refused, or the PR is behind or conflicted, bring `origin/main` in with the relay's `pr_update_branch` (or have the PR's dev merge `origin/main` and resolve). That is a real merge commit, so CI re-runs; it is never an empty commit.
3. Only a second red that measured something is real, and is then handled as a failure.
The seat states which step it took in its landing note.

## Suggested route (the skills lane decides)

- Add `.github/workflows/check-links.yml` to `RERUN_FAILED_WORKFLOWS`, or replace the closed list with a reviewed allowlist of read-only check workflows.
- Keep every existing fence: once per run, the run's head equals the PR head, and no re-run of a run that measured something and failed.

## Acceptance

`rerun-failed.mjs --run <check-links run id>` dispatches and re-runs the failed job once. A second attempt on the same run is refused.
